notes.title: Purrounding Patch Notes[v.2.0]
notes.notes:
[i][b][New Features][/b][/i]  
[b]- Cat Tower has been added.[/b]  
[i]A basic Cat Tower and a special supporter-exclusive Cat Tower are now available.[/i]  
[b]- Startup program setting is now available.[/b]  
[i]You can enable or disable the program from launching on startup in the settings menu.[/i]  
[i]No need to run the program manually—your cat will always be there to greet you![/i]  
[b]- Treehouse & Tropical themes have been added.[/b]  
[i]Discover newly added furniture, toys, windows, and theme songs![/i]  
[i]The Treehouse theme includes 11 medieval-style classical tracks,[/i]  
[i]while the Tropical theme adds 15 bossa nova lofi tracks full of summer vibes.[/i]  
[b]- Siamese Cat has been added.[/b]  

[i][b][Improvements][/b][/i]  
[b]- Drag & Drop motion has been improved.[/b]  
[i]When you drag and release the cat, a new “plop” drop animation has been added.[/i]  

[i][b][Other Notes][/b][/i]  
[b]- New motions have been added with this update.[/b]  
[i]To apply your existing customization to the newly added motions,[/i]  
[i]please press the Save button once in the customization tab upon first launch after the update.[/i]
